chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: WFAA broadcasts, dance tours and a year and a half at the hotel
summary: The band broadcasts on a powerful station, books its own dances at $75-90 a man, and stays a year and a half.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: AND WHERE DID YOU GO FROM THE ADOLPHIS. THERE SHOULD HAVE BEEN A LOT OF, YOU DIDN'T SAVE ANY OF THE CLIPPINGS, ANY OF THE PUBLICITY STUFF THAT YOU HAD FROM I sure didn't.
THERE MUST HAVE BEEN GANGS OF PUBLICITY ABOUT THAT.

We were broadcasting, one of the first bands to broadcast over this powerful station WFAA. It was a good thousand watt station years ago. They got us all the way up to Canada and it was a powerful station. That's the reason when Trent's band went on a tour, we would make from 75 to 80 or 90 dollars a piece a nite, because we booked the dances ourselves, hired guys to be on the door, in other words, when we got ready to split up the proceeds there would be between $75 and $90 a nite we used to make. That was real fantastic money.
YEAH, YEAH, THAT WAS A LOT OF BREAD.
Well, we stayed in the Adolphis for a year and a half.
THAT LONG, WAS THIS CONSECUTIVE, OR YOU CAME BACK, YOU WENT OUT AND CAME BACK.
Well, we went out once for, we had a two week vacation.
THAT'S THE TIME THEY HAD THAT BAND THAT DIDN'T WORK OUT.

They sent for us to come back. Well after we had been there for about close to a year, we went out and stayed a month, that's when we made these tours. Then we used to play most all of the universities down there and we played at the Governor's Ball and
